cancel.comment: Dialog dismiss button — cancels the action and closes the dialog.

ok.comment: Generic confirm button on an informational result dialog (acknowledge / dismiss); iOS reuses it for the custom-theme cap-reached alert.

delete.comment: Generic delete action label / a11y description (custom-theme card menu item, dictionary row delete).

back.comment: Back-navigation a11y contentDescription for the TopAppBar navigationIcon on Android host sub-screens. Android-only: iOS uses the system NavigationStack back button (OS-locale, not overridable to the in-app picker). Custom in-app nav controls follow the display-language picker; only OS-locale nav chrome (tab titles) stays on the OS locale.

viewWebsite.comment: Link button opening an official website in the browser (data sources + the app's own site).

exportFailed.comment: Error message shown when exporting user dictionary data fails.

values.ja: エクスポートに失敗しました

importFailed.comment: Error message shown when importing user dictionary data fails.

values.ja: インポートに失敗しました

moeDict.comment: Display name of the MOE Taiwanese dictionary data source.

values.hanji: 教育部臺灣台語常用詞辭典
values.en: MOE Dictionary of Common Taiwanese Words
values.ja: 教育部 台湾語常用語辞典

newwordDict.comment: Display name of the PTS Taigi new-word lexicon data source.

values.hanji: 公視台語台台語新詞辭庫
values.ja: 公視台語台 台湾語新語辞書

kunggeDict.comment: Display name of the NTCRI craft-terminology lexicon data source.

values.hanji: 工藝中心臺灣台語工藝詞庫
values.ja: 工芸センター 台湾語工芸用語辞書

iTaigiDict.comment: Display name of the iTaigi crowd-sourced dictionary data source.

taiwanJapanDict.comment: Display name of the Taiwanese-Japanese Grand Dictionary (Taigi translation) data source.

values.ja: 台日大辞典 台湾語訳

taiHuaDict.comment: Display name of the online Taigi-Mandarin cross-reference dictionary data source.

values.ja: 台湾語・華語オンライン対照辞典

taiwanPlantDict.comment: Display name of the Taiwan plant-name glossary data source.

sttiDict.comment: Display name of the MOE academic-subject terminology Taigi translation data source.

values.hanji: 教育部學科術語臺灣台語對譯
values.ja: 教育部 学術用語 台湾語対訳

accentDict.comment: Display name of the regional accent / pronunciation-variation supplement data source (Android key was khpooDict; canonical name unified with iOS).

fontSystemDefault.comment: Keyboard font option: the OS system default typeface.

fontOpenHuninn.comment: Keyboard font option: JF Open Huninn (粉圓) typeface.

fontIansui.comment: Keyboard font option: Iansui (芫荽) typeface.

fontGenYoMin.comment: Keyboard font option: GenYoMin (源樣明體) serif typeface.

fontGenYoGothic.comment: Keyboard font option: GenYoGothic (源樣烏體) sans-serif typeface.
